text:
Samir Patel: Quick check — we have a candidate (Eden) booked Tue 3pm PDT for looped backend + culture. Can folks confirm who will own the system-design portion vs the deep-dive code exercise?
Elena Kim: I can take system-design.
Jordan Lee: I can do the code deep dive. will need a small contrived problem, ~25m.
Samir Patel: Awesome — Jordan, could you paste the prompt or link to the snippet you'll use? Also, Priya, is the Zoom + recording permission handled?
Jordan Lee: Yep, prompt is simple — small service design + a short async code task. Paste below:```Design a minimal URL-shortener service: data model, key generation, high-level endpoints, and one scaling consideration. Then implement a naive encode/decode in your language of choice (15-20 lines).```
Priya (People Ops): Zoom room is created and set to record. We need candidate consent at start. I sent the calendar invite with recording note but I'll also add a quick consent line in the intro slide.
Rachna: Who's scribing/taking notes for the debrief? I can if no one objects.
Samir Patel: Thanks Rachna — please scribe. Can you capture 3 anchors: correctness, system tradeoff reasoning, and communication? We'll use the standard rubric but call out those anchors in debrief.
Priya (People Ops): Reminder: debrief window is 48h — please add scores to Greenhouse within that time. Also note timezone: candidate in GMT+1 so 3pm PDT is 11pm local — flagged for sensitivity.
Elena Kim: Noted. Any accessibility accommodations?
Priya (People Ops): Candidate requested captions — Zoom live captions enabled by default in the room.
Jordan Lee: Two quick asks: 1) can someone open a small repo/drive for the candidate code if they prefer to paste; 2) do we want a short warmup problem to verify their environment?
Samir Patel: Good call. Calendar-bot: create a temporary Google doc titled "Eden - interview code" and share edit link with panel at 3pm.
calendar-bot: Done — https://docs.google.com/eden-interview-3pm (record created)
Rachna: I'll put the rubric anchors in the doc and leave a scribe section.
Samir Patel: Perfect. Final checklist: Elena (design) ✅, Jordan (code) ✅, Rachna (scribe) ✅, Priya (ops + consent/captions) ✅. Any objections?
Elena Kim: all good from me :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: good to go
Priya (People Ops): good — I'll DM candidate consent template to you, Samir.
Samir Patel: Thanks all. I'll ping again 1h before as a reminder.
Priya (People Ops): Reminder logged — debrief reminder scheduled for 24h after the interview (to nudge reviewers).
